title: Multiplication subroutine semantics
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string, $B$ a natural-number bound, $k$ one of the two multiplication sites, $q$ a rational number, and $\sigma$ a register state. Suppose every register of $\sigma$ is at most $B$, and the value in the result register plus the product of the two input-register values is at most $B$. Suppose also that for every natural number $z\le B$, the universal probabilistic program started at the exit site associated with $k$, with its outer counter set to the first input value, its inner counter set to $z$, and its result register set to the original result value plus the product of the input values, has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $q$. Then the program started at the entry site associated with $k$ and register state $\sigma$ has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is one of the two multiplication sites
Every register of $\sigma$ is at most $B$
The original result-register value plus the product of the two input-register values is at most $B$
For every natural $z\le B$, the specified exit-site configuration has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $q$
